source.class: real persistent self-improvement promotion path with merged candidate-local anytime-valid gate

positive_evidence.candidate_local_anytime_gate: PACE is implemented as a testing-by-betting e-process over paired candidate-vs-champion discordant outcomes; commit threshold is 1/alpha, ties discarded, pair budget fail-safe rejects; gate is additive and off by default
positive_evidence.promotion_wiring: runCandidateNotify applies existing guardrails first, then PACE; continue or reject blocks promotion, commit permits later replay/canary/promotion gates
positive_evidence.durable_sufficient_statistics: candidate-vs-champion human A/B outcomes are aggregated into persisted skillopt_bandit_arms; PACE notification reconstructs candidate wins/losses as challenger Alpha-1/Beta-1
positive_evidence.restart_property_of_current_count_mode: because PACE promotion is recomputed from persisted aggregate counts rather than in-memory e-process wealth, process restart does not by itself erase the current terminal-wealth sufficient statistic
positive_evidence.scope: per candidate only; RFC and implementation explicitly do not claim run-level/familywise protection

logical_comparison_identity_before_evalu.evidence: manual A/B delivers champion and challenger first, then creates a fresh per-invocation comparisonToken; live A/B similarly creates a fresh token only when recording the pick

paired_evidence_atomicity.evidence: recordSkillOptABPick persists the ranked feedback event first; champion and challenger bandit arms are then incremented by two separate IncrementBanditArm calls, each with its own SQL transaction

comparison_to_bandit_dedupe.risk: no inspected unique comparison/event id is passed into IncrementBanditArm, so bandit mutation is not visibly idempotent per comparison

crash_windows: after ranked feedback event but before either bandit arm: evidence row exists but PACE sufficient statistic does not include it
after champion-arm increment but before challenger-arm increment: paired posterior state is asymmetric; PACE candidate count itself remains unchanged but auxiliary champion confidence is inconsistent

after challenger-arm increment but before command completion: retry/new invocation can mint a new comparison token and add another candidate outcome; no inspected transaction proves exactly-once logical comparison consumption
durability_gaps.stream_order_loss: current promotion seam uses aggregate terminal counts, not a persisted ordered PaceAccumulator; this deliberately gives an order-invariant terminal-wealth test, not preservation of an earlier streaming threshold crossing
durability_gaps.cross_candidate_spending: explicitly absent from the PACE contract; per-candidate alpha does not control familywise false promotion across many candidates
durability_gaps.remote_evaluation_exactly_once: not established in this path; both candidate responses are delivered before the comparison identity used for durable feedback is minted

proposed_atomic_evidence_transaction: mint stable logical_comparison_id before either candidate/champion evaluation
bind champion/candidate artifact IDs, prompt/input digest, evaluator/human identity and query/statistical reservation to that ID
make provider calls retry-safe under that ID or reconcile UNKNOWN provider outcomes
store one immutable comparison outcome keyed by logical_comparison_id
in the same database transaction, apply both champion and challenger arm updates exactly once using a unique applied_comparison row
derive PACE candidate-local state from immutable comparison rows or transactionally maintained sufficient statistics
release promotion feedback/statistical transition exactly once
keep cross-candidate error spending in a separate durable ledger if run-level control is desired
falsification_tests: SIGKILL after feedback event persist but before first arm increment; resume must converge to exactly one comparison and two symmetric arm updates
SIGKILL between champion and challenger arm updates; resume must not leave permanent asymmetry or count a different comparison as repair
SIGKILL after both arm updates but before CLI completion; retry must not count the logical comparison twice
replay same logical_comparison_id with modified candidate/champion/prompt digest must fail
after restart PACE decision from durable state must equal uninterrupted execution
many-candidate null simulation must be reported separately because candidate-local alpha is not familywise
exact_next_action: Search GitMoot or another public self-improvement system for a transaction that atomically binds one immutable comparison/event ID to both paired sufficient-statistic updates and a persisted sequential-test state, then check whether its evaluation/provider calls are also logical-query-idempotent. If absent, use this exact GitMoot seam as a concrete prototype target for comparison-level idempotency and crash injection, while separately searching for durable cross-candidate statistical spending and an adaptive-selection-unused outer test.
